note: Clean, well-kept RV park in Clayton minutes from Raleigh; paved streets and driveways, large patios, shady lots. Daily, weekly and monthly stays. Dogs on leash only; the park bars breeds such as German Shepherd, Pit Bull, Chow and Rottweiler. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site: Day $60 / Week $300 / Month $825, all sites full hookup with 50-amp; added no free Wi-Fi, reservation by request form. Site count (25, from note prose) not stated by the operator, left. Note trimmed of hookup/site-count text.
flags: Price gate: base $60/night (operator's site, no year shown, read 2026-10-22) is over US$50, but the park is 17 km from Raleigh (metro gateway), so the gate is lifted. No family stays.

Long-stay character to judge: the operator advertises 'Monthly, Weekly, and Daily Campsites ... Long Term Stays' with a $825 monthly rate including electric, and the only booking path is a reservation REQUEST form that asks 'Have you ever been convicted of a felony?' and for the camper's model year before 'Someone from our team will contact you'. If the park is long-stay in character, that screening question looks like the 'background check / approval' that fails long-stay test 2, though a nightly rate is posted on its own site with a phone. No site count or nightly share is published (test 4 passes by default).
